thought: She runs a bamboo and wood craft unit in Manipur that employs more than 50 artists - and the Prime Minister noticed.
support: Margaret Ramtharsiem, from Churachandpur district, works in Manipur's traditional bamboo and wood craft forms. Her unit employs over 50 artists and has built market reach into multiple states including Delhi. She also offers free skills training to young people several times a year, building a pipeline of new artisans rather than just running a business. PM Modi featured her in the 129th episode of Mann Ki Baat on December 28, 2025, speaking about women preserving traditional culture and art while creating jobs. From a home workshop to a 50-artist enterprise - and a direct line back into training the next generation.
